posts.text: Roughly doubling revenue at scale for a large company used to be something special, but super intelligence makes that look slow!

quote.author: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.name: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.text:
Elon Musk says Cloudflare is underestimating how much AI agents will take over the internet.

MUSK: “Agentic internet traffic already exceeds human traffic... Cloudflare predicted that in five years, agentic AI traffic will be a thousand times more than human traffic. And if anything, I think that is underestimating.”

Ron Baron, whose firm is a major SpaceX investor, says he has modeled Starlink at $1 trillion in revenue and a $14–15 trillion valuation within 10 years, and now thinks that’s “really light.”

MUSK: “Starlink revenue is growing very rapidly... roughly doubling revenues per year at large scale. I remember when that used to be a big deal.”

Every AI agent needs bandwidth and compute. SpaceX is building both.

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Elon Musk tells Ron Baron why SpaceX catches Starship with the launch tower’s “chopsticks”

“It’s kind of like Mr. Miyagi in Karate Kid, you know, catching the fly, but just make it bigger.”

“The rocket is placed on the launch pad by the tower and then is caught by those same tower arms and placed back on the launch pad when it returns from space.”

“You really couldn’t get faster reusability than landing back where you took off.”

“This, in principle, would allow us to refly the rocket, the giant booster, the Super Heavy booster, once an hour.”

Most rockets are still thrown away after one flight.

Starship is being built to fly like an airplane.

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Elon Musk just revealed an absolutely insane revenue trajectory for SpaceX: on track to exceed $100 billion annualized in December, a best guess of over $500 billion by December next year, and a trillion is no longer out of the question

"I think, just to comment on a few of those things, so we are tracking to have an annual rate of revenue, that is in excess of $100 billion in December. Obviously, December's pretty close, so I have good insight into that, so unless there's some natural disaster or something, we will meet that target. And then based on the plans that we have next year, it seems quite likely that our annual recurring revenue in December of next year will exceed 500 billion.

Now, this is not a promise, this is what I think will happen, this is my best guess. Just want to distinguish between this is a promise to do something versus what I think will occur. What I think will occur is an ARR in December of next year of 500 billion, and I simply said, a trillion is not out of the question, meaning it was previously out of the question and it is no longer out of the question, it's maybe 2% or something likelihood

But it's interesting that it's not 0%, that's the interesting part. And the probability is increasing with time”

posts.text: Armies that win have the general at the front lines. Nobody wants to bleed for the prince in the palace.

quote.author: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.name: KanekoaTheGreat
quote.text:
Ron Baron asked Elon Musk how many CEOs live on site in an Airstream and work hands-on with everyone.

MUSK: “Airstreams are actually pretty nice... It’s parked right next to the power plant.”

“We built this power plant that’s producing over a gigawatt... in about a year, as opposed to normally about five years.”

“There is no upstairs.”

He walks the entire site up to five times a day. He’s pulled power cables “the size of an anaconda,” run fiber, wired switches, and worked on the power plant software.

“I try to do at least a little bit of everything, so that I’m not numb to the pain of the people who are actually doing it.”

“It’s not as though I’m sitting in an office and somebody has to come to me. I’m walking the floor, asking them questions actively.”

There’s a reason SpaceX is winning the compute race.

posts.text: Tesla self-driving gives mobility to seniors

quote.author: cb_doge
quote.name: DogeDesigner
quote.text:
Larry is 98 years old, and he bought a Tesla Model Y because of Full Self-Driving.

His first car was a 1931 Ford Model A. After 80 years behind the wheel, he says driving with Tesla FSD feels more relaxing. He even took his Model Y on a road trip to Colorado and called the drive “a breeze.”

For older drivers, that extra help can take some of the stress out of a busy drive across town. It can also make it easier to say yes to a weekend with the grandkids.

I love that Tesla is building technology that can help people stay independent as they get older. Being able to tell your family “I’ll come see you this weekend” and make the trip on your own schedule means a lot. ♥️

quote.author: cb_doge
quote.name: DogeDesigner
quote.text:
Starlink helped save six lives in the Atlantic. 

The Estonian yacht Cekritito was taking on water off Spain. Captain Madis Rallmann used Starlink to send a distress message to volunteer rescuers in Estonia. They passed it to maritime authorities, and a Spanish Coast Guard helicopter flew out to the crew.

One by one, all six sailors were lifted from their life raft and flown safely to Vigo.

The yacht sank hours later.
